titles.native: 好きってなんだろう… 涙

description: Music video directed by ShiShi Yamazaki for the song Sukitte Nandarou... Namida by YUKI (Yuki Kuramochi). The full version of the music video was officially released on YouTube for a limited time before the single's drop on July 29, 2015. It was also included on DVD with a limited edition release.
